meta.title: Buyer enables Show Best Prices and the QCS gains a best-price row
gaps: Verify that each Best Price value equals the lowest vendor bid for its corresponding line item across all vendors.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that each Best Price value equals the lowest vendor bid for its corresponding line item across all vendors.

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for the case, with bids available.
Navigate to the event's comparison screen where the Actions control is available.
Open the QCS after enabling best prices and assert that the comparison grid rendered.
Assert that the QCS contains at least one Best Price row label.
Assert that a Best Price QCS cell is populated.
